purpose: Paired genuine Bazel 9.3.0 vs native bazel-rs capture of load-time rule declarations (aspect/transition/select/OutputGroupInfo/config.*/rule() params/attr extensions). A: mirrors every step of tests/load_declarations.rs on byte-identical copies of tests/fixtures/load_declarations; B: one error probe per ported diagnostic; C: load-time value probes written by ctx.actions.write.

native.binary: target/debug/bazel-rs (rebuilt from the worktree before capture)

environment: env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin LANG=C.UTF-8 LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 HOME/TMPDIR private, umask 022; scratch under /tmp/opencode removed=True

verdicts.EXACT: query stdout / written value bytes identical
verdicts.EXACT_MESSAGE: both fail; native primary message appears verbatim in Bazel stderr (framing differs)
verdicts.EXPECTED_NATIVE_UNSUPPORTED: native fails explicitly by design (feature accepted at load time but not analyzed); Bazel result recorded
verdicts.REFERENCE_CRASH: genuine Bazel crashed (exit 37, internal error); native result recorded
verdicts.MISMATCH: exit class differs, or both fail with a native message not present in Bazel stderr (both messages recorded)
